title: Practical Skills in HCI; Augmented Reality Design: Concepts and Applications
description: The goal of this course is to introduce augmented reality (AR) as a design tool and medium. We will explore the challenges and opportunities for accessibility, user experience design, and user interfaces for 3D content and experiences along with the conceptual and technical skills necessary to create impactful AR experiences. We will examine the compelling use cases for AR, with an emphasis on crafting digital interactions with the real world, and how AR offers new ways to share and understand various types of information and data.
